AnalysisMetric.description:
Operations supported by the decision intelligence module.
Rejects arbitrary or unsupported queries.

Phase 2 additions:
- OVERVIEW: snapshot-level summary (encounters, images, cameras, time coverage).
- SPECIES_ENCOUNTER_COUNTS: deduplicated encounter/species contributions.
- CAMERA_COMPARISON: per-camera/site encounter and species counts.
- DAILY_ACTIVITY: encounter counts grouped by calendar date.
- HOURLY_ACTIVITY: encounter counts grouped by hour-of-day (0-23).
- SPECIES_CAMERA_MATRIX: species × camera count matrix.
- EFFORT_NORMALISED_RATES: encounters per active camera-day.
AnalysisMetric.title: AnalysisMetric

InclusionPolicy.description: Policy governing which detections are admitted into analytical aggregations.
InclusionPolicy.title: InclusionPolicy

description:
Request payload for conclusion-sensitive review prioritization.
Ranks unreviewed detections by their potential marginal impact on a selected metric.

target_metric.description: Operational metric whose sensitivity guides review priority.

species_ids.description: Scope review ranking to particular species hypotheses.
species_ids.title: Species Ids

camera_ids.description: Scope review ranking to particular camera traps.
camera_ids.title: Camera Ids

inclusion_policy.description: Inclusion baseline for computing marginal delta.

top_k_candidates.description: Number of alternative label candidates evaluated per detection.
top_k_candidates.title: Top K Candidates

score_margin_threshold.description: Ambiguity margin threshold between top species prediction and highest alternative species score (default: 0.25). Detections with margin > threshold in probability score space are considered unambiguous and excluded from the candidate queue unless explicitly flagged for expert review.
score_margin_threshold.title: Score Margin Threshold

result_limit.description: Maximum number of top-ranked results to return after evaluating all eligible candidates (default: 50). Fewer requested results does NOT mark an otherwise complete response as partial.
result_limit.title: Result Limit

evaluation_limit.description: Evaluate only a bounded subset of candidate detections during simulation. Applying this limit produces incomplete ranking coverage and sets status to PARTIAL.
evaluation_limit.title: Evaluation Limit

evaluation_policy.description: Selection policy when evaluation_limit is set (e.g. 'all_eligible', 'time_order').
evaluation_policy.title: Evaluation Policy

min_confidence.description: Minimum detection/classification confidence cutoff for baseline metric parity.
min_confidence.title: Min Confidence

target_species_id.description: Focal species for sensitivity ranking (e.g. for SPECIES_ENCOUNTER_COUNTS or CAMERA_COMPARISON).
target_species_id.title: Target Species Id

camera_id_a.description: First camera identifier for CAMERA_COMPARISON difference metric (camera_a - camera_b).
camera_id_a.title: Camera Id A

camera_id_b.description: Second camera identifier for CAMERA_COMPARISON difference metric (camera_a - camera_b).
camera_id_b.title: Camera Id B

start_time.description: Start of analysis time window (must be timezone-aware if given).
start_time.title: Start Time

end_time.description: End of analysis time window (must be timezone-aware if given).
end_time.title: End Time

include_zero_impact.description: Whether to include candidates whose maximum absolute marginal impact is 0.
include_zero_impact.title: Include Zero Impact

title: ReviewRankingRequest
